name: Bleached Patch Coat
note: No two coats are alike; the patches here (a flag scrap, a planet print, bleached denim) are the kinds the collection used.

name: Marble Sweater
note: Price is a judgement from a thin market (no sold listing; comparable knits ask 600 to 700). The grey-white colourway is taken from collection imagery, not a product page: the one reference page's photograph was gone.

name: Blood Wound Shirt
note: Price is a judgement: the only asking price found is 2,500 for the tank top, and the long-sleeved shirt is rarer. The beads and sequins are drawn, not modelled.

name: Floral Embroidered Jeans
note: Price is a judgement from a dealer-only market with no published sales. The embroidery is drawn flat: its layout follows the dealer photographs (a lily at the hip, a peony on the other thigh, sprays at the hems).

name: Ice Jacket
note: The jacket changes colour with the cold; it is painted part-way through the change, blue above and green where it has cooled, as the pair of photographs shows it.

name: Mille Miglia Goggle Jacket
note: The goggles sit in the hood as it lies down the back.

name: Skeleton Bone Knit Sweater
note: The skeleton is on the back and the sleeves, as on the real sweater; the front is plain. It is laid on as a drawing, so the bones do not show the knit's own stitches changing colour.

name: Boro Reconstructed Denim Jacket
note: Every real jacket is pieced differently; this is one arrangement. The scraps lie edge to edge rather than overlapping, and their sashiko is rows of running stitch only.

name: Shark Full-Zip Hoodie
note: The hood lies down the back in the game and cannot be zipped over the face, so the shark is drawn where it shows: across the back of the lowered hood, with WGM and the tiger patch above it. The camouflage has no ape heads hidden in it.

name: Box Logo Hoodie
note: The grey and red hoodie stands for a family released most seasons since 1994; the lettering is the nearest heavy oblique on the build machine, not Futura.

name: Leopard Nuptse Jacket
note: The Supreme name beside the back shoulder logo is placed from recollection, not from a product page.

name: Rottweiler Graphic Tee
note: The photograph of the dog is redrawn as a vector head: the pose, markings and bared teeth are kept, the fur is not photographic.

name: Seven-Layer Jacket
note: The inner layers are one garment painted as six, their edges stepped back at the front; three more show below the hem.
